label: Five-machine synthesis: A-D + Machine E (chiral reversible)
description: Synthesises a fifth W33 machine (E) from the chiral sector identified in Pass 4340 cross-connection and Pass 4342 Levi partial order. Machine E is chiral reversible: it uses the depth-4 Levi partial order as its causal skeleton and the biased-symmetric frame hybrid from B/C path.

construction.chiral_bit: position 1 of frame set to 1 (asymmetric under Levi automorphism)
construction.chiral_gate_description: Implements Levi partial order reversal: maps past->future to future->past within one depth-4 causal shell. Reversible by construction (inverse = apply twice).

classification.chiral_advantage: E provides 10 opcodes with chiral gate at reversible thermodynamic cost; bridges B-expressiveness with C/D reversibility

frontier_status.next_frontier: Pass 4345: Machine E chiral gate formal proof + holonet integration
open_questions: Can Machine E chiral_gate be realised as a W33 Levi automorphism?
Does the depth-4 Levi partial order extend to a full lattice?
Is there a Machine F (chiral irreversible) completing the 2x3 classification?

conclusion: Five W33 machines now synthesised: A-B (irreversible), C-D (reversible achiral), E (reversible chiral). The five-machine set covers all combinations of {irreversible, reversible} x {biased, symmetric, chiral} except chiral irreversible (candidate Machine F). Machine E is constructed from first principles using the Levi partial order and B/C hybrid frame.
